title: Idle caret
scenario: A focused single-line TextField, editable and read-only, for 10 s; plus a focused 64 Ki-unit multiline TextField, idle, then wheeled by quarter notches and paged down. Proves G1; with FX5, G4. The fixture clock advances 100 ms per step (500 ms on the multiline field) with one animation tick per step when animation is pending; a native 8 ms timer would deliver about ten times as many wakes in real time. Motion on; caret settings pinned to Windows' defaults (530 ms blink, 5 s caret timeout).
